questions.question: Write an essay on dietary fiber: types, sources and functions.
questions.solution_html:
• Introduction (2 Marks)
  • Dietary fiber refers to indigestible parts of plant foods (cellulose
  • hemicellulose, pectin, lignin, etc.) that pass through the digestive system
  • largely unchanged.
  • It plays a vital role in digestive health and prevention of lifestyle diseases.
  • Soluble fiber: Dissolves in water forming gel-like material. Examples: pectin
  • gums, mucilage.
  • o Found in oats, barley, apples, citrus fruits, legumes.
  • Insoluble fiber: Does not dissolve in water; adds bulk to stool. Examples
  • cellulose, lignin.
  • U]
  • o Found in whole grains, bran, nuts, and vegetables.
  • Sources (2 Marks)
  • Whole cereals and pulses (wheat bran, oats, lentils)
  • Fruits and vegetables (apples, carrots, leafy greens)
  • Nuts and seeds
  • Functions (3 Marks)
  • Promotes normal bowel movement and prevents constipation.
  • Helps control blood sugar and cholesterol levels.
  • Aids in weight management by increasing satiety.
  • Lowers risk of cardiovascular diseases and colon cancer.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: • Lowers risk of cardiovascular diseases and colon cancer.
